name: Deadwind Pass
summary: A foul wind sweeps Deadwind Pass, where the road runs between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows. Karazhan rises at the heart of the pass, its ruined tower still tainted by Medivh's death. Ogres and ghosts haunt the canyon, and no town offers shelter.

sections.title: A Canyon of Bones and Howling Wind
sections.body:
Deadwind Pass lies between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows. Its ravines cut through pale stone and petrified wood. Once counted as part of the Redridge Mountains, the pass is now a hollow scar. A foul wind tears through the gorge, and sudden lightning under a gray sky makes metal arms dangerous to carry.

Totemic effigies hang from dead branches beside the main road, warning travelers to keep moving. No fertile soil or mineable veins offer reason to stay. No town or flight master can give aid.

sections.title: The Legacy of Karazhan
sections.body:
Karazhan dominates Deadwind Pass, built above a powerful meeting of ley lines. The tower was Guardian Medivh's stronghold, where he plotted to open the Dark Portal and bring ruin to Stormwind. During the First War, Lord Anduin Lothar and the young Khadgar led an expedition into the tower after Medivh's madness and possession came to light. They killed him there.

His death released fel taint across the pass and Duskwood. Karazhan remains an ominous ruin, and its unstable magic still leaks into the land.

sections.title: Deadwind Ogres and Ruined Plots
sections.body:
South of the main road, Deadwind ogres hold the territory around the Vice. Clad in foul rags and armed with jagged iron, they ambush anyone who ventures near the southern road. Reports say they serve a hidden master nearby.

Farther south, Morgan's Plot holds the skeletal remains of a hamlet that once served the tower. Ruins above ground and twisting cellars echo with wailing phantoms and restless shades, the dead left by Karazhan's unleashed sorcery.

sections.title: The Scythe and the Dark Riders
sections.body: Cloaked Dark Riders emerge from Deadwind Pass, then return to its shadows. They have recently terrorized Duskwood, killing innocent homesteaders as they hunt for the Scythe of Elune.

faq.q: Why is this place so dead and ruined?
faq.answer: Karazhan's magic and Medivh's dark sorcery ruined Deadwind Pass. When Medivh was killed in the tower during the First War, fel magic burst through the ravine. It petrified trees, stripped life from the earth, and blighted the sky.

faq.q: Are there any friendly towns, inns, or flight masters here?
aliases: is there a town in deadwind pass
faq.answer: No friendly towns, inns, or flight masters serve either faction in Deadwind Pass. Alliance travelers rely on Darkshire to the west in Duskwood. Horde travelers set out from Stonard to the east in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: What is Karazhan's place in Deadwind Pass?
faq.answer: Karazhan was Guardian Medivh's tower, where he worked to open the Dark Portal. It remains an ominous landmark amid Deadwind Pass's withered trees, unstable magic, and restless dead.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Riders and where did they come from?
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are cloaked figures who ride out of Deadwind Pass to hunt powerful relics, including the Scythe of Elune. They have brought terror to nearby Duskwood.

faq.q: Can I gather herbs or mine ore in Deadwind Pass?
faq.answer: Deadwind Pass has no useful herb or ore gathering nodes. Carrion birds and hostile ogres roam its barren ground.

faq.q: Who lives in Deadwind Pass today?
faq.answer: Deadwind ogres around the Vice, carrion birds, and restless ghosts occupy the pass. A few wandering human scavengers survive on the move without Alliance support.

angles.text: The ley lines beneath Deadwind Pass converge at Karazhan. Mages regard the nexus with dread, knowing Medivh warped its arcane conduit to breach dimensional barriers.
Raw demonic energy still clings to the rocks and stone cellars. Medivh's possession and the pass's necromantic history left a lasting stain of fel magic.
Stormwind sees Deadwind Pass as a grim scar on its borders. The horrors from Karazhan ended Duskwood's old splendor and still threaten Darkshire down the western road.
Travelers heading west from Stonard face a hostile bottleneck. Vengeful human spirits and hulking ogres attack anyone entering the gorge.
